stage: before first new noise-diagnostic execution; observations were already exposed in M9/M10
two_sided_color_test: After candidate-frequency derotation, use unitary DFT. High modes have abs(fftfreq)>=fs/4; low modes have 0<abs(fftfreq)<fs/4. Ranks sum N-1 and both annihilate the assumed tone exactly. Test both energy-ratio tails with quantization-safe cone distance.

levels.allocation: half to rank-two carrier-frequency set, quarter to each color tail; Bonferroni requires no cross-record independence

continuous_domain_enclosure: Use training reference g and validation R=abs(vdot(u_g/sqrt(N),z))/norm(z). The frequency cone cannot accept where |<u_f,u_g>|/N <=k and R-k>tau+q*sqrt(1+tau^2)/norm(z). Dirichlet bound k<=1/[N*sin(pi*D/fs)] excludes all alias distances >=D when its strict score is positive. Derive D conservatively; if the bound fails report no global enclosure. On the enclosed arc, a color-cone score has Lipschitz constant <=(1+tau)*2pi*norm(t*z). A fixed maximum0.01Hz mesh plus this margin can certify empty intersection in exact arithmetic; floating computations remain numerical evidence unless error budgets are checked.
not_a_fit: No covariance learned and reapplied to claim independent test. No tracking-implied frequency chosen by sign/lag optimization.
potential_pivot: If isotropic error direction is unsupported or contradicted, preserve failure and identify the needed independently calibrated filter/covariance supplier, then move to a distinct cross-domain reconstruction.
